title: Nepali Currency Denomination Classification Using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and MobileNetV2: An Experimental Comparison
abstract: arXiv:2611.33713v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated currency denomination recognition is a computer vision task with applications in cash handling, financial technology, and assistive systems. This study classifies seven Nepali currency denominations (Rs. 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 500, and 1,000) using three configurations: a conventional convolutional neural network (CNN), MobileNetV2 with transfer learning, and MobileNetV2 with hyperparameter tuning. A compiled dataset of 16,249 images was used, comprising 10,500 training, 3,500 validation, and 2,249 independent test images. Images were resized to 128 x 128 pixels, normalized, and augmented to vary orientation, scale, illumination, and appearance. Models were evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and precision-recall and ROC analysis. The hyperparameter-tuned MobileNetV2 achieved the highest validation accuracy (95\%), with precision, recall, and F1-score of 0.93, 0.91, and 0.92, but reached only 84\% accuracy on

translated_title: 使用卷积神经网络（CNN）和MobileNetV2进行尼泊尔货币面额分类：一项实验性比较
translated_abstract: 自动货币面额识别是一项计算机视觉任务，在现金处理、金融科技和辅助系统中具有广泛的应用。本研究对七种尼泊尔货币面额（5、10、20、50、100、500和1000卢比）进行分类，采用了三种模型配置：传统卷积神经网络（CNN）、采用迁移学习的MobileNetV2，以及经过超参数调优的MobileNetV2。研究使用了一个包含16,249张图像的编译数据集，其中包括10,500张训练图像、3,500张验证图像和2,249张独立测试图像。图像被调整为128 x 128像素，经过归一化处理，并通过方向、尺度、光照和外观的多样化变换进行了数据增强。模型使用准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数以及精确率-召回率分析和ROC分析进行评估。经过超参数调优的MobileNetV2达到了最高的验证准确率（95%），其精确率、召回率和F1分数分别为0.93、0.91和0.92，但在（原文在此处被截断）……上的准确率仅为84%。
tldr: 经过超参数调优的MobileNetV2在七种尼泊尔货币面额分类任务中表现最优，实现了95%的验证准确率，优于传统CNN和采用迁移学习的MobileNetV2。
en_tdlr: Hyperparameter-tuned MobileNetV2 outperforms a conventional CNN and a transfer-learning MobileNetV2 in classifying seven Nepali currency denominations, achieving the highest validation accuracy of 95%.
